name: Brunei (protectorate, 1906–1959)
description: A yellow field with two diagonal stripes of white and black running from the upper hoist to the lower fly.
history: The yellow flag of the Sultan with the white and black diagonals added in 1906, when Brunei became a British protectorate: the two stripes stand for the two wazirs who signed the 1906 agreement with the Sultan. The red national crest was added on 29 September 1959 with the proclamation of the constitution.
